name: Transparent Network

verification.source: SEP-1 stellar.toml, resolved live; issuer attribution confirmed against each issuer account's own on-chain home_domain

caveats: A return is the honest failure mode. An anchor that accepts value, fails to settle and keeps it produces no return event and scores 0. A low rate is the absence of one kind of evidence, not evidence of good conduct.
Dark means no on-chain settlement in over 30 days. That is a fact about the ledger. Why an anchor is quiet is not something this project claims to know.
